channel.title: Pranit Harekar
channel.description: Notes on building software and leading the people who build it.

item.title: Thanks for the shot
item.description: Ten years ago I landed at JFK with a couple of bags and a scholarship. On America's 250th, a note of gratitude for the shot.

item.title: Being right is the trap
item.description: For years, being technically correct is how you win. Then you step into a lead role and the same playbook quietly stops working.

item.title: Technical debt is a financing decision, not a moral failing
item.description: Teams that treat all debt as shameful end up hiding it. Teams that treat it as a lever end up managing it.

item.title: Why I built this
item.description: This isn't a portfolio. It's just me documenting thoughts and sharing experiences, because in the AI era problem solving and storytelling matter more than a grid of logos.
